This is a telecom fraud using a fake base station to send SMS, i.e., fraud (诈骗). Possibly also illegal use of telecom equipment (非法设立、使用伪基站) which is a crime of "非法设立移动通信基站" or "非法使用移动通信终端设备" but typical Chinese criminal law includes "非法获取电信业务经营许可证" etc. However typical classification: "诈骗罪" (fraud) for sending fraudulent messages to obtain money. Also "非法设立移动通信基站罪"? Not sure if there is a specific crime. In Chinese criminal law, there is "非法获取电信业务经营许可证罪" and "非法使用移动通信终端设备罪". But the examples show they often just label as "诈骗". For similar case: sending fraudulent SMS is considered "诈骗罪". So answer likely "诈骗". No other crimes like "非法获取电信业务经营许可证" not mentioned. So single crime: 诈骗.
